name: project-state
description: Turn any multi-stakeholder project into a system where routine reporting is a byproduct of normal work. 42 skills for milestones, objectives/KPIs, phase gates, document curation, status reports, defect/feedback registration to GitHub issues, funder/grant compliance, and a local kanban — driven by swappable compliance packs (PIC, grant-Canada, board/investor, client-services, agile, open-source) and capability plugins (Canadian SR&ED with guided onboarding and T661 audit review; tender intelligence).
